mapper.update: UPDATE stock SET sale = sale + 1, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{stockId} AND sale < count
mapper.select: SELECT count - sale FROM stock WHERE id = #{stockId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fulfillment_ticket_order (order_no, user_id, stock_id, visit_slot, ticket_status, fulfillment_status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{stockId}, #{visitSlot}, #{ticketStatus}, #{fulfillmentStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

INSERT INTO visitor_reservation_task (order_no, reservation_no, user_id, visit_slot, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{reservationNo}, #{userId}, #{visitSlot}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

INSERT INTO fulfillment_outbox_event (event_id, order_no, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{orderNo}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT order_no, user_id, stock_id, visit_slot, ticket_status, fulfillment_status, create_time, update_time FROM fulfillment_ticket_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT order_no, user_id, stock_id, visit_slot, ticket_status, fulfillment_status, create_time, update_time FROM fulfillment_ticket_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stock_id = 22 AND visit_slot = #{visitSlot}

SELECT order_no, reservation_no, user_id, visit_slot, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error_code, last_error_message, operator, complete_time, create_time, update_time FROM visitor_reservation_task WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT order_no, reservation_no, user_id, visit_slot, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error_code, last_error_message, operator, complete_time, create_time, update_time FROM visitor_reservation_task WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT event_id, order_no, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time FROM fulfillment_outbox_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now}) ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE fulfillment_outbox_event SET status = 'SENT', retry_count = retry_count + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE fulfillment_outbox_event SET status = 'CONSUMED', update_time = #{now} WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
UPDATE fulfillment_outbox_event SET status = 'PENDING', next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, update_time = #{now} WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
UPDATE fulfillment_outbox_event SET status = 'MANUAL', update_time = #{now} WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
UPDATE fulfillment_outbox_event SET status = 'PENDING', next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, update_time = #{now} WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
UPDATE fulfillment_outbox_event SET status = 'MANUAL', update_time = #{now} WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
UPDATE visitor_reservation_task SET status = 'PROCESSING', update_time = #{now} WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRYING')

UPDATE visitor_reservation_task SET status = 'VISITOR_SUCCESS', operator = #{operator}, complete_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now}, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}

UPDATE visitor_reservation_task SET status = 'RETRYING', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = #{now} WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}

UPDATE visitor_reservation_task SET status = 'MANUAL_PENDING', retry_count = #{retryCount}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, next_retry_time = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
UPDATE fulfillment_ticket_order SET fulfillment_status = #{status}, update_time = #{now} WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
